posts.title: NASA Invites Media to Crew Completion of Yearlong Mars Simulation
posts.lead: The four volunteers who lived and worked in a simulated NASA Mars mission for more than a year will exit their habitat on Saturday, Oct. 31, after 378 days of isolation in a facility at the agency’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.
